description: Rotating router: eight inputs to eight outputs, with every connection shifted along by one on a button press or a trigger

params.text: Shifts every routing up by one on each press, the top input wrapping round to the bottom output
Shifts every routing down by one on each press, the bottom input wrapping round to the top output
Puts the routing back to its start on each press, input 1 to output 1 and each later input to the output of the same number

inputs.text: One of the signals carried through the router; which output it reaches moves by one each time the routing rotates
A trigger here shifts every routing up by one, the top input wrapping round to the bottom output
A trigger here shifts every routing down by one, the bottom input wrapping round to the top output
A trigger here puts the routing back to its start, input 1 to output 1 and each later input to the output of the same number

outputs.text: Carries whichever input the current rotation has routed to it, and a red lamp marks the output fed by input 1

notes: the number of routes in use follows the highest input with a cable in it, and a green lamp beside an input shows that input is within that range
this module is monophonic: only the first channel of a polyphonic cable is read, and every output carries a single channel
menu: Active Routes — fixes the number of routes at 2 to 8, or Determine by connected inputs, which takes it from the highest input with a cable in it
Inactive Routes Passthrough — sends each unused input straight to its own output instead of 0V

inputs.8: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.9: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.10: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
